market.question: Will the highest temperature in San Francisco be between 66-67°F on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Forecast for May 8 SFO is high ~61°F (16°C). Market range 66-67°F is above forecast median. SF May average highs are 64-66°F so 66-67°F is plausible if forecast underestimates, but more likely landing in 60-65°F range. Probability of exactly 66 or 67°F is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast can vary ±3-5°F; the exact 2°F bin is narrow.
